svg.text: engines from the login shell's PATH,
environment cleared but for HOME, USER,
host: this node; the port is kept
principal: the Unix user of the uid,
a render that fails never replaces
records data dir, runs root, port,
no db_dir unless it was given
spectio doctor reads it all back: one line per check, exit 1 on any fail
